summary.en: The Venezuelan army bombed an ELN guerrilla camp in Apure, killing at least 19 rebels, while a U.S. drone strike hit an ELN drug depot nearby, causing at least 20 deaths. The United States is negotiating a long-term military presence in Venezuela and Trump has suggested a one-day operation to capture Maduro. A U.S. soldier was arrested and is now in court for betting $400,000 on Maduro's removal. Oliver Blanco met a U.S. official in Washington as these negotiations continue. The UCDP counted 2 battle-related deaths in 2007, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Den venezuelanske hæren bombet en ELN-guerrillaleir i Apure, og drepte minst 19 opprørere, mens et amerikansk droneredning traff et ELN-narkotikalager i nærheten, og forårsaket minst 20 dødsfall. USA forhandler om en langsiktig militær tilstedeværelse i Venezuela, og Trump har foreslått en ett-dagers operasjon for å fange Maduro. En amerikansk soldat ble arrestert og står nå i retten for å ha satset 400 000 $ på at Maduro skulle bli avsatt. Oliver Blanco møtte en amerikansk tjenestemann i Washington mens disse forhandlingene pågår. UCDP registrerte 2 kamprelaterte dødsfall i 2007, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Crisis in Venezuela
background.extract: An ongoing socioeconomic and political crisis began in Venezuela during the presidencies of Hugo Chávez, Nicolás Maduro as well as Delcy Rodríguez. It has been marked by hyperinflation, starvation, disease, crime, and mortality rates, resulting in massive emigration. Food shortages and hyperinflation have ended, but inflation remains high. It is the worst economic crisis in Venezuela's history and considered by some sources as more severe than the Great Depression in the United States, the 1985–1994 Brazilian economic crisis, or the 2008–2009 hyperinflation in Zimbabwe. In 2019, the Institute of International Finance called it the single largest economic collapse outside of war in 45 years. Writers have compared aspects, such as unemployment and GDP contraction, to Bosnia and Herzegovina after the 1992–95 Bosnian War, and those in Russia, Cuba and Albania following the Revolutions of 1989.
